Description: Order (receipt) identifier, sequential in time. One order = one or more rows (lines).
Derivation / Formula: TXN-nnnnnnn, assigned after sorting orders by business date and time

Description: Line number within the order (1..n).
Derivation / Formula: Transaction_ID + Line_No is the primary key

Description: Business date (YYYY-MM-DD). Sales after midnight (until 03:00 in Ramadan, 01:00 Thu-Sat) belong to the previous business date, as in a real POS end-of-day.
Clock time of the order (HH:MM:SS). Missing for orders keyed in manually during the 2024-10-15 POS outage and for ~0.05 % random sync errors.
Derivation / Formula: Sampled from the segment's intraday profile

Description: Day of week name. Saudi work week is Sunday-Thursday.
ISO-8601 week number (Monday start). Weekly summaries use Sunday-start Saudi weeks.
Month number 1-12.
Month name.
Calendar quarter 1-4.
Calendar year.
1 on Friday and Saturday (Saudi weekend).
1 on official public holidays: Founding Day, National Day (+ bridge days), Eid Al-Fitr days 1-4, Day of Arafah and Eid Al-Adha days 1-4.
Meteorological season: Winter (Dec-Feb), Spring (Mar-May), Summer (Jun-Aug), Autumn (Sep-Nov).

Known business events active that day, ' | ' separated (Ramadan, Eid, national days, promotions, post-promotion dip, Salary Week = payday to +4 days). 'No Event' otherwise. Weather and operational anomalies are deliberately NOT labelled.
In Session / Exams / Term Break / Summer Vacation (approximate Saudi MoE calendar).
Loyalty member ID (Cnnnnnn) or corporate account (CORP-nn). Empty for Guest (non-member) orders - this is structural, not an error.
Derivation / Formula: Persistent customer pool; same ID re-appears across visits

Description: New = member's first ever order; Returning = member seen before (members registered before 2023 are Returning on their first 2023 visit); Guest = not identified.
Product code P001-P040.
Product name.
Espresso Drinks, Iced Coffee, Specialty Coffee, Tea & Matcha, Other Beverages, Bakery, Desserts, Sandwiches, Seasonal.
Units of the product on this line (>= 1). Corporate bulk orders carry 5-20.
Derivation / Formula: Count of identical items in the basket

Description: VAT-exclusive selling price per unit on that date (menu price / 1.15, rounded to 0.01). Stable with scheduled price changes.
Revenue before discounts.
Discount granted on the line (promotion, loyalty free drink, corporate agreement).
Derivation / Formula: = round(Gross_Sales x promo rate, 2); loyalty: one unit free

Description: Name of the discount applied to the line or 'No Promotion'.
Refund value when the line was returned/refunded (wrong order, quality complaint). Product is still consumed/wasted so COGS remains.
Net revenue of the line.
Standard cost per unit (ingredients + packaging) on that date.
Derivation / Formula: Base cost x scheduled cost changes

Description: Cost of goods sold for the line.
Gross profit of the line after discounts and refunds.
mada, Apple Pay, Credit Card, Cash, STC Pay, Delivery App (aggregator-paid), Corporate Invoice. ~0.35 % missing (sync errors) + POS-outage orders.
In-Store, Drive-Thru, Mobile App (launched 2023-09-10), Delivery App. ~0.25 % missing.
Card/wallet processing fee on the line.
Derivation / Formula: = round(Net_Sales x rate): mada 0.8 %, Apple Pay 0.9 %, Credit 2.2 %, STC Pay 1.5 %, Cash/Invoice/Delivery 0

Description: Aggregator commission on delivery orders.
Derivation / Formula: = round(Net_Sales x 22 %) in 2023-2024, 20 % from 2025-01-01; 0 for other channels
